title: 第3章 忽发的车祸
content_zh:
“砰！”法拉利的车头重重的撞上了街边一家时装店的墙角，停了下来，巨大的声音惊动了街上所有的人。

原来就在危急时刻，钟晓飞猛的一个急跳，伸手抓住了时装店的广告牌的管状支架，双臂用力，像是玩单杠一样，整个身子凌空的上提翻滚，正好躲过了疾驶而来的车轮，“砰！”的，当法拉利的车轮撞上墙角的时候，广告牌的支管再也承受不住钟晓飞的重量，咔嚓一声的折断了。

钟晓飞重重的摔在了法拉利的引擎盖上，然后又滚落到了地上，连滚了好几圈。

刚才的生死关头，钟晓飞良好的身体素质和机敏反映，发挥了救命的作用，不然他今天不死也重伤。在大学的时候，钟晓飞是学校的运动健将，短跑长跑，单杠双杠都是他的拿手绝活，还曾经参加过第八次全国大学生运动会，虽然只拿到两枚银牌，但以他真正的大学生身份和财经专业和那些体育专长生比赛，他这样的成绩已经算是相当的优秀了。

“啊！”法拉利车里的女生一直在尖声的惊叫，她闭着眼睛，双手捂着耳朵，以为自己已经撞死了人……

钟晓飞从地上爬起来，摸着腰，呲牙咧嘴，全身到处都在疼。

时装店的老板和员工都冲了出来，围住了法拉利，拍着车窗要车里的女孩下车。

女孩睁开了眼，死活不想下车，等到发现自己并没有撞死人的时候，她好像才放心了，然后推开车门下车。

“会开车吗？看把我的店都撞成什么了？广告牌都让你撞烂了！”时装店的老板生气的指责女孩。

红衣女孩一把推开他，冲到钟晓飞的面前，激动的说，“哎呀，你……没死？太好了太好了！”

钟晓飞抬头看，发现面前的女孩青春靓丽，肌肤雪白，大大的眼睛，束着一条马尾，身穿红色的短袖t恤，胸前鼓鼓的，黄色的运动短裤、露出两条雪白修长的大腿，脚穿一双白色的慢跑鞋，整个人充满了运动的活力。现在女孩激动的看着钟晓飞，脸蛋潮红，眼角还挂着晶莹的泪珠。

要是钟晓飞死了，她肯定得坐牢，所以她的激动是人之常情。

见到撞自己的是一个美女，钟晓飞的心里欣慰了许多，如果对方一个男的，那钟晓飞肯定是怒发冲冠！指着对方鼻子一顿臭骂，说不定还会给对方一个老拳，骂对方的十八辈祖宗，但既然是一个女孩子，自己又没受伤，钟晓飞心里的火气就不那么大了。

“哎呀，你想撞死我啊？！”钟晓飞不满的说了一句。

“对不起啊对不起。”女孩子说话像是连珠炮，清脆又迅速，“我开的太快了，你受伤没有啊？我送你去医院。”

钟晓飞伸伸胳膊，踢踢脚，又摸摸腰，弹弹身上的灰，呲牙咧嘴的说，“啊呀，你惨了，我现在全身到处都痛，头还晕，估计不是脑震荡也是内出血，你不赔我一个十万、八万的，我就跟你没完！”

“嗯，没问题，你要十万还是八万？”女孩子想都没有想的就回答。

钟晓飞愣住了，他原本只是想开一个玩笑，没想到女孩子居然答应了，一开口就答应给十万八万！这种情况只有三个可能，第一，女孩子特别有钱，根本不把十万八万当回事，只想给钱了事。第二，这女孩子是个疯子。第三，这女孩子是装疯，她使用的是缓兵之计，钟晓飞现在说什么她都答应，但以后她不会认账。

钟晓飞仔细的看女孩子，觉得对方不像是疯子也不像是装疯，又看看女孩子所开的红色的法拉利跑车，这样的车，价值起码在百万以上，但撞上墙角之后，女孩子一点心疼的样子都没有。

看来，这个女孩子还真是一个有钱人。

一个女孩子长的青春漂亮，又这么的有钱，肯定是有些来头的。不是她爸有钱，就是她男人有钱。

“这车是你的？”钟晓飞指指法拉利。

“车撞成这样，修理起码得花个十几万吧？”

“不管它，反正以后我不会再开它了，破车，刹车都刹不住，害人家差点撞了人……”女孩子埋怨。

钟晓飞无语，心说法拉利要是破车，那大街上面的其他轿车不都成三轮了？

周围围观的人越来越多。交警估计也快到了。

“好了，你欠我十万块，明天把钱打到我的账户上。记住了，少一分也不行。”钟晓飞非常严肃的说了一句，然后转身分开周围围观的人群，就要离开。

“咦？你怎么走了，你还没有跟我去医院呢？”女孩子非常的意外。

“医院就不用了，我这个人最怕去医院，你直接赔我钱就拉倒了，不用去医院。”钟晓飞笑嘻嘻说话的口气完全就像是一个专业碰车党。

不过傻子也能看出来，钟晓飞并不想要女孩的赔偿。

“那怎么行？还是去医院吧，不去医院以后万一有后遗症怎么办？”女孩子很感动，一边说，一边伸出小手抓住钟晓飞的胳膊。周围围观的人群太多了，堵的钟晓飞根本走不出去，他轻易的就被女孩子“活捉”。

钟晓飞穿的是一件短袖的衬衣，两条胳膊都光着呢，被她的小手一掐，感觉光滑柔腻，软软的，非常的舒服。

“不用了，我今天有急事。你要是真想替我检查，就把检查的费用连同那十万块一起打给我吧……”钟晓飞轻轻的挣脱了女孩的小手，往人群里钻。

“有急事也要先去医院啊？”女孩子又想捉他，但这一次没有捉住。

“喂，别跑啊，你还没有告诉我你叫什么名字呢？还有账户……”女孩子在钟晓飞的身后猛喊。

女孩子愣了一下，又喊，“喂，你也不想知道我叫什么名字吗？”

钟晓飞回头笑，“你叫什么名字？”

“我叫陈美莎，美丽的美，莎士比亚的莎。”

“哦，我记住你了，美丽的莎士比亚。”

“还有，你要记住我的手机号，如果身体不舒服，就赶快去医院检查，然后给我打电话！撞了你真对不起，喂喂，我的手机号，你别跑啊，你站住！……”陈美莎一边追，一边歪着脖子喊，但钟晓飞早跑远了。只有她的呼喊还在随风飘散……

钟晓飞一路小跑着离开现场，头也没有回，心说反正也没有撞着，去医院检查不过是浪费时间，这个女孩子心肠不错，长的也美，经过这一次的教训，以后开车应该不会这么快了吧？

对于肯德基的东西，钟晓飞不是太喜欢，但也绝对不讨厌，起码卫生条件比起来，肯德基比一般的中餐馆要好的太多了，而且是二十四小时营业，不随便涨价，只这个，就比中餐馆强。

下午肯德基的客人不是太多，钟晓飞轻松的排队，买了汉堡薯条、果汁，在付款的时候，那个脸蛋圆圆，皮肤白白，笑起来很甜的女服务生冲着钟晓飞笑了又笑。钟晓飞也冲她笑，结果，那个女服务生眨着大眼睛笑的更厉害了。不但她笑，连其他的服务生和店里的客人也都在暗暗的笑。

钟晓飞莫名其妙，心说怎么了？难道帅也是一种犯罪？

顺着大家的目光，把手向后脑摸了摸，终于找出了问题所在。

原来，刚才车祸，他在地上滚落的时候，头发和衣服上不知道在哪里沾上了白漆，可能是新刷的停车线一类的吧，现在，他就像是白头翁一样，得意洋洋的正站在柜台前面美呢。

那个眼睛很大，皮肤很白的美女服务生，小声而体贴的跟他说，“先生，那边有卫生间。”指指右边。

钟晓飞钻进卫生间，匆匆的去洗了一下头发，虽然没有洗干净，但总算不那么白了。回来后，冲着美女服务员感激的笑，心说这个大眼睛白皮肤的美女服务员是新来的吧？以前没见过，她漂亮的样子，有点像是吴怡洁啊。

想到吴怡洁，钟晓飞心里又激动又沮丧。

到ty公司三年了，和吴怡洁连一句话都还没有说过呢，每天看着她绝美的身姿从面前飘过，钟晓飞觉得自己像是一个癞蛤蟆，吴怡洁这块天鹅肉，他肯定是啃不着的。现在他只希望，吴怡洁能这么永远的保持下去，永远的独身，不要交男朋友，让他能够继续的垂涎下去。

钟晓飞拎着汉堡薯条离开肯德基，向家走，快走到刚才车祸现场的时候，他看见时装店的门前还围着好多人，有一辆拖吊车正在拖吊那辆红色的法拉利，交通很堵，几个交警在现场维持交通秩序，哨子一直在响。

钟晓飞伸着脖子看了几眼，然后远远的绕开。他可不想被人认出来，然后被交警叫住调查。

走回小区，忽然的刮过了一阵风，道边的小树呼呼的摇摆。

他没有看见雨，却看见一个黑黑的东西，从旁边的高楼阳台慢慢的飘落下来。

钟晓飞的眼睛立刻就直了，因为他已经看见那是一条女用内裤，一条黑色的性感无比的蕾丝小内裤！
content_en:
"Bang!" The front of the Ferrari slammed into the corner of a fashion store on the street and stopped. The loud sound alarmed everyone on the street.

It turned out that at the critical moment, Zhong Xiaofei jumped suddenly, reached out and grabbed the tubular bracket of the billboard of the fashion store, and used both arms hard, like playing with a horizontal bar, and lifted his whole body up and rolled, just in time to avoid the speeding wheels. "Bang!" When the Ferrari's wheel hit the corner, the branch pipe of the billboard could no longer bear Zhong Xiaofei's weight and broke with a click.

Zhong Xiaofei fell heavily on the hood of the Ferrari, and then rolled to the ground again, rolling several times.

In the critical moment of life and death just now, Zhong Xiaofei's good physical fitness and alert reflexes played a life-saving role, otherwise he would have been seriously injured today even if he had not died.When he was in college, Zhong Xiaofei was an athlete at the school. He was good at sprinting, long-distance running, and horizontal and parallel bars. He also participated in the Eighth National University Games. Although he only won two silver medals, as a true college student, he competed with finance majors and those sports majors. His results are already quite outstanding.

"Ah!" The girl in the Ferrari kept screaming. She closed her eyes and covered her ears with her hands, thinking that she had killed someone...

Zhong Xiaofei got up from the ground, touched his waist, grinned, and felt pain everywhere in his body.

The owners and employees of the fashion store rushed out, surrounded the Ferrari, patted the windows and asked the girl in the car to get out of the car.

The girl opened her eyes and didn't want to get out of the car. When she found out that she had not killed anyone, she seemed relieved and then opened the door and got out of the car.

"Can you drive? Look what happened to my store. You smashed the billboard!" The owner of the fashion store angrily accused the girl.

The girl in red pushed him away, rushed to Zhong Xiaofei, and said excitedly, "Oh, you... are not dead? That's great, great!"

Zhong Xiaofei looked up and found that the girl in front of him was young and beautiful, with snow-white skin, big eyes, a ponytail, wearing a red short-sleeved T-shirt with a bulging chest, yellow sports shorts, revealing two slender white thighs, and a pair of white jogging shoes. She was full of sports energy.Now the girl looked at Zhong Xiaofei excitedly, her face flushed, and there were crystal tears hanging from the corners of her eyes.

If Zhong Xiaofei died, she would definitely go to jail, so her excitement was only natural.

Seeing that the person who bumped into him was a beautiful woman, Zhong Xiaofei felt a lot relieved. If the other person was a man, then Zhong Xiaofei would definitely be furious!Pointing at the opponent's nose and scolding him, he might even give him a punch and scold him for his eighteen generations of ancestors. But since he was a girl and he was not injured, Zhong Xiaofei was not so angry.

"Oh, you want to hit me to death?!" Zhong Xiaofei said dissatisfied.

"I'm sorry, I'm sorry." The girl's words were like rapid fire, crisp and fast, "I drove too fast. Are you injured? I'll take you to the hospital."

Zhong Xiaofei stretched his arms, kicked his feet, touched his waist, flicked the ashes on his body, and grinned, "Oh, you're miserable. I feel pain all over my body now, and my head is still dizzy. It's probably either a concussion or internal bleeding. If you don't pay me a hundred thousand or eighty thousand, I will never end it with you!"

"Well, no problem. Do you want 100,000 or 80,000?" the girl answered without thinking.

Zhong Xiaofei was stunned. He originally just wanted to make a joke, but the girl actually agreed and promised to give him one hundred and eighty thousand as soon as he opened his mouth!There are only three possibilities for this situation. First, the girl is very rich and doesn't take one hundred or eighty thousand seriously at all. She just wants to give money to solve the problem.Second, this girl is crazy.Third, this girl is pretending to be crazy. She is using a delaying tactic. She agrees to whatever Zhong Xiaofei says now, but she will not admit it in the future.

Zhong Xiaofei looked at the girl carefully and felt that she did not look like a madman or pretending to be crazy. He also looked at the red Ferrari sports car that the girl drove. Such a car is worth at least one million, but after hitting the corner, the girl did not look distressed at all.

It seems that this girl is really a rich person.

A girl who is young, beautiful, and so rich must have some background.Either her father is rich or her man is rich.

"Is this car yours?" Zhong Xiaofei pointed at the Ferrari.

"If the car crashes like this, repairs will cost at least hundreds of thousands, right?"

"Ignore it, I won't drive it anymore anyway. It's broken, the brakes can't stop, and I almost hit someone..." the girl complained.

Zhong Xiaofei was speechless, thinking that if the Ferrari was broken, wouldn't all the other cars on the street have three wheels?

There are more and more people watching around.The traffic police are probably arriving soon.

"Okay, you owe me 100,000 yuan. The money will be transferred to my account tomorrow. Remember, even one cent less will not matter." Zhong Xiaofei said very seriously, then turned around and separated from the crowd of onlookers, and was about to leave.

"Huh? Why are you leaving? You haven't gone to the hospital with me yet?" The girl was very surprised.

"There's no need for a hospital. I'm the most afraid of going to the hospital. You can just pay me for it and I won't go to the hospital." Zhong Xiaofei smiled and spoke like a professional car bumper.

But even a fool can see that Zhong Xiaofei does not want compensation from the girl.

"How can that be done? Let's go to the hospital. What if there are sequelae if we don't go to the hospital?" The girl was very moved. As she said this, she reached out her little hand to grab Zhong Xiaofei's arm.There were too many people watching around, and Zhong Xiaofei was so blocked that he couldn't get out. He was easily "captured alive" by the girl.

Zhong Xiaofei was wearing a short-sleeved shirt with both arms bare. When pinched by her little hands, it felt smooth, soft and very comfortable.

"No, I have something urgent today. If you really want to check for me, just pay me the cost of the check together with the 100,000 yuan..." Zhong Xiaofei gently broke away from the girl's little hand and went into the crowd.

"If there is an emergency, you have to go to the hospital first?" The girl wanted to catch him again, but this time she failed.

"Hey, don't run. You haven't told me your name yet? And your account..." the girl shouted behind Zhong Xiaofei.

The girl was stunned for a moment, then shouted, "Hey, don't you want to know my name too?"

Zhong Xiaofei turned around and smiled, "What's your name?"

"My name is Chen Meisha, beautiful Mei, Shakespeare's Sha."

"Oh, I remember you, fair Shakespeare."

"Also, you have to remember my mobile phone number. If you feel unwell, go to the hospital for a checkup and call me! I'm sorry if I bumped into you. Hey, my mobile phone number, don't run away, stop!..." Chen Meisha chased her while tilting her neck and shouting, but Zhong Xiaofei had already run away.Only her shouts are still drifting in the wind...

Zhong Xiaofei trotted away from the scene without looking back. He thought to himself that there was no collision anyway, and going to the hospital for a check-up was just a waste of time. This girl has a good heart and is beautiful. After this lesson, she shouldn't drive so fast in the future, right?

Zhong Xiaofei doesn't like KFC's food very much, but he definitely doesn't hate it. At least in terms of sanitary conditions, KFC is much better than ordinary Chinese restaurants. Moreover, it is open 24 hours a day and does not increase prices arbitrarily. This alone is better than Chinese restaurants.

There were not many customers at KFC in the afternoon. Zhong Xiaofei queued up easily and bought hamburgers, fries, and juice. When paying, the waitress with a round face, fair skin, and a sweet smile smiled at Zhong Xiaofei.Zhong Xiaofei also smiled at her. As a result, the waitress blinked her eyes and smiled even harder.Not only was she laughing, but the other waiters and customers in the store were also laughing secretly.

Zhong Xiaofei was confused and thought, "What's wrong?"Is being handsome a crime?

Following everyone's gaze, I touched the back of my head and finally found the problem.

It turned out that when he rolled to the ground in the car accident, his hair and clothes were stained with white paint somewhere. It might have been the newly painted parking lines. Now, he was standing in front of the counter as proudly as a white-headed man.

The beautiful waitress with big eyes and fair skin said to him in a low and considerate voice, "Sir, there is a bathroom over there." She pointed to the right.

Zhong Xiaofei got into the bathroom and hurriedly washed his hair. Although it was not washed thoroughly, it was finally not so white.After coming back, I smiled gratefully at the beautiful waitress and thought to myself that this beautiful waiter with big eyes and fair skin is new here, right?I've never seen her before. She looks a bit like Wu Yijie in her pretty appearance.

Thinking of Wu Yijie, Zhong Xiaofei felt excited and frustrated.

It has been three years since I came to TY Company, and I haven't even said a word to Wu Yijie. Watching her beautiful figure passing by in front of me every day, Zhong Xiaofei feels like a toad. He must not be able to chew Wu Yijie's swan meat.Now he only hopes that Wu Yijie can remain single forever and not have a boyfriend, so that he can continue to covet her.

Zhong Xiaofei left KFC with his hamburger and fries and walked home. When he was almost at the scene of the car accident, he saw many people gathered in front of the fashion store. A tow truck was towing the red Ferrari. The traffic was heavy. Several traffic police were at the scene to maintain traffic order, and their whistles kept sounding.

Zhong Xiaofei stretched his neck and took a few glances, then walked away from a distance.He didn't want to be recognized and then stopped by the traffic police for investigation.

Walking back to the community, there was a sudden gust of wind, and the small trees along the road were swaying.

He didn't see the rain, but he saw a black thing slowly falling from the balcony of the tall building next to him.

Zhong Xiaofei's eyes immediately went straight, because he had already seen that it was a pair of women's underwear, a pair of black and extremely sexy lace panties!
